description: ocsp.rs lines 116-119: if single.next_update is None, the upper-bound validity check is skipped. RFC 6960 §4.2.2.1 states nextUpdate is optional but when absent the response is valid indefinitely. Silently accepting an OCSP response with no nextUpdate means a stale 'good' response could be used forever. This is the same security hole as in CrlChecker for absent nextUpdate: an old cached OCSP response remains valid with no expiry.
title: OcspChecker skips nextUpdate check when next_update is absent
